LAWRENCE, Mass. — We arrested Gregori Thomas Romero, an illegally present Dominican national. He’s charged with:
•Sexual assault
•Strangulation/suffocation
•Assault & battery w/dangerous weapon
•Domestic assault

🔍Boston police arrested him Sept. 11, 2024, on these charges. We attempted to lodge an immigration detainer, but he’d already been released from custody. ICE Boston — along with many in the community — are relieved he’s off the streets while facing charges.
